unsupported.text: `BULK LOAD`, though `bcp` is supported as a preview feature.
unsupported.reason: BULK is a denied keyword in isEndpointWrite.

USER is in isEndpointWrite's allow-list beside ROLE. Whether that was deliberate for user-authored statements is not recorded; the emulator provisions each caller's database user itself (internal/tds/principal.go). A divergence to decide.

unsupported.text: `FOR JSON` must be the last operator in the query, so you can't use it inside subqueries.
probes: SELECT (SELECT a FROM dbo.t FOR JSON PATH) AS j
unsupported.reason: The guard judges what a batch WRITES; it does not read query shape. The engine, not the guard, would have to refuse a subquery FOR JSON.

probes: CREATE STATISTICS s ON dbo.t (a, b)
unsupported.reason: CREATE followed by anything outside the allow-list is refused.

probes: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW dbo.mv AS SELECT 1 AS x
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX ix ON dbo.v (a)
unsupported.reason: Neither object kind is in the allow-list. SQL Server's own spelling of a materialized view is an indexed view: a view plus a clustered index, and the index is refused.

probes: SELECT * FROM PREDICT(MODEL = dbo.m, DATA = dbo.t) AS p
unsupported.reason: A read: the guard forwards it and SQL Server, not the guard, would decide.

unsupported.text: Queries targeting system and user tables
unsupported.reason: The sentence does not say which system tables, or what targeting one means, so there is no statement to probe. Left unclassified rather than guessed.

probes: WITH r AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 3) SELECT * FROM r
unsupported.reason: A read: the guard forwards it and SQL Server accepts recursive CTEs.

unsupported.text: Schema and table names can't contain `/` or `\`
probes: CREATE VIEW dbo.[a/b] AS SELECT 1 AS x
CREATE VIEW dbo.[a\b] AS SELECT 1 AS x
unsupported.reason: VIEW is allow-listed and the guard does not read object names.

probes: SELECT a FROM dbo.t FOR XML PATH
unsupported.reason: A read: forwarded, and SQL Server accepts FOR XML.
SET is not a write, so the guard forwards it.
